name: WebCatalog
summary: Turn web apps into tidy desktop apps and manage multiple accounts side by side. Less tab chaos, more focus — your whole stack organized in one place.
best_for: people juggling many web apps and multiple accounts per service who want them as clean, separate desktop apps with per-profile isolation
skip_if: browser tab discipline or built-in PWA installs already cover you, or you use a handful of apps with single accounts
honest_knock: It solves a real annoyance: dozens of web apps and multiple accounts per app as tidy desktop windows. The honest question is whether you need the paid tier at all. The free plan's 2-app limit is tight, but browser profiles and PWAs solve part of the same problem for free. Pro earns its fee when multi-account juggling (several Gmail/Slack/WhatsApp identities) is daily reality.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month billed annually, or $6 monthly
pricing.notes: (re-read 25 September 2026 on webcatalog.io/en/pricing in a browser, both billing toggles, USD) Basic is free and no card is required: 2 desktop apps, 2 profiles and 1 space, with cloud sync, to-dos, focus mode and curated wallpapers. Pro is $5 per user per month billed annually or $6 billed monthly, plus local taxes, and lifts the caps to unlimited apps, profiles and spaces, with an ad-free experience, pages, theme colours, an ads and tracker blocker, an app lock, location services and priority support. Business is $8 per user per month billed annually or $10 monthly and adds shared spaces, shared pages, team management, centralised billing, an activity log and SAML single sign-on. Both paid plans carry a 7-day trial. The page advertises a 20% saving on yearly billing and prices in USD, EUR or JPY. A legacy lifetime licence is not mentioned on the pricing page (checked 2026-09-25).
